static_traits.name: 黎茜
static_traits.social_status: 与Female儿关系因自责而有些紧张；有支持性的配偶，但与家人讨论这些感受存在困难
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without以往相似心理问题史；not yet接受过既往心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、条理性较强，能进行自我Reflection与合作；情绪略显紧张但配合度高

basic_info.main_problem: 因为在和Female儿们一起钓鱼的过程中她们have not钓到鱼，我觉得自己是个糟糕的钓鱼老师。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些自我not足感和自责影响了我与Female儿们的关系以及我对钓鱼的享受，促使我寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: 我是一个糟糕/not称职的老师（家长）
Student（Female儿）是否成功完全取决于我

special_situations.event: 与Female儿们外出钓鱼却without人上鱼的经历反复出现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I were a good teacher, they should be able to catch fish; otherwise it is my failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断加大教学与技巧训练，把责任全部揽在自己身上
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她们not钓到鱼It is all my fault，我是个糟糕的老师

special_situations.event: 钓鱼过程中Female儿们表现出享受与兴奋，但依旧have not钓到鱼
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有抓到鱼的结果才算成功，过程中的快乐not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive experiences, focuses excessively on the single result of 'whether a fish was caught'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她们not抓到鱼，这次就算失败

special_situations.event: 多次外出钓鱼后仍not yet成功上鱼，压力感增强
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 好老师应该确保Student达成目标；如果have not达成，就是老师not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets rigid high standards and harsh demands for himself, driving improvement through self-blame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要她们还not上鱼，我就是失败者

core_conflict.wish: 渴望成为能带来成功与快乐的好Mother/好老师，被Female儿们认可与需要
core_conflict.fear: 害怕让Female儿们失望、被视为without能，从而损害与Female儿的情感联结
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over outcomes by attributing all responsibility to oneself
以高标准自我苛责以避免面对not可控因素（运气、兴趣、学习阶段）

object_relations.self_representation: not称职、需要not断弥补失败的老师/Mother
object_relations.object_representation: 需要自己保证成果、可能会失望的Female儿们

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师强调亲子互动的积极面（如Female儿们享受过程、联结与回忆）时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将关注积极面等同于忽视not yet上鱼的“失败”，担心这意味着自己承认not称职
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和但自责的语气重复“都是我的问题/我教得not好”，弱化外部因素；用抽象标准评判自己，回避当下情感体验。

manifestations: Reduces the meaning of fishing to 'whether a fish is caught', ignoring the value of parent-child companionship and connection
把自我价值与结果捆绑，一旦not yet上鱼便negate自我
outcomes: 对钓鱼这一爱好的Reduced interest and pleasure

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 反复use“好老师应该确保Student成功”的僵化标准评判自我
Internalizes 'whether a fish bites' as the only standard of success

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: When talking about positive experiences, quickly returns to one's own faults and responsibility attribution
Maintains a sense of control over outcomes through self-blame, limiting engagement with present enjoyment

positive_force: Spouse is supportive and willing to listen
Female儿们在钓鱼过程中享受时光与陪伴，存在积极亲子互动的基础
The client has a positive attitude and is willing to do cognitive restructuring and reality testing
职业功能not yet受影响，具备一定心理韧性
negative_force: An attribution style that fully personalizes outcomes (self-blame)
Rigid 'should' standards and high expectations (performance-oriented self-worth)
negate积极体验，过度聚焦失败证据
Difficulty communicating emotions with family leads to limited use of support

target_behavior.behavior: 在与Female儿钓鱼相关的情境中反复出现的自责与负性自动思维
antecedent: 外出钓鱼时Female儿们not yet能钓到鱼
回想以往not yet上鱼的经历或筹划下一次钓鱼
target_behavior.core_reason: 将“好老师必须确保Student成功”的规则Introjection，并采取个人化归因，将not可控因素（运气、学习阶段、兴趣差异）视为自身失败
target_behavior.function: 获得对局面的主观控制感并试图通过自责驱动改进，同时回避承认外部not可控带来的without力感
target_behavior.consequence: 亲子Relationship tension、压力与失落感增加，对钓鱼的兴趣与愉悦下降
